children: began evacuating non-essential workers from its Stones, Mars, Olympus, Ursa, Vito and Appomattox offshore production assets in the US-regulated northern Gulf of Mexico on Tuesday, the company said in a statement posted online.

The US National Hurricane Center forecast a developing storm off the coast of Mexico to become a hurricane by Thursday that will cross offshore production areas before making landfall in either Louisiana or Mississippi.
